title: Sb2Se3/CdSe thin film photocathode for efficient hydrogen production
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,16653-16660
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00129G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Liting Wei, Yinhu Yu, Tong Chang, Jiao Jiao, Yangfang Wu
Owing to the successful construction of Sb2Se3/CdSe p–n heterojunction, the Sb2Se3/CdSe/Pt PEC device achieves a photocurrent density of ca. −6.9 mA cm−2 at −0.2 VRHE, which is 2.3 times higher than the Sb2Se3/Pt.
